::: {#fig-hist-chol}

```{r}
wcgs |>
  ggplot2::ggplot() +
  ggplot2::aes(x = chol) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Cholesterol (mg/dL)", y = "Count")
```

Histogram of total cholesterol in the WCGS dataset

:::

@fig-hist-chol shows a single-peaked distribution
with a longer right tail than left tail:
`r round(100 * mean(wcgs$chol >= 150 & wcgs$chol <= 350, na.rm = TRUE))`%
of the values lie between 150 and 350 mg/dL,
but the largest value is `r max(wcgs$chol, na.rm = TRUE)` mg/dL.
